---
title: "Sample quality dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    social: menu
    theme: cosmo
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library('flexdashboard')
library('DT')
library('ggplot2')
dat.file <- list.files(path = ".", pattern = "*quality.csv", full.names = TRUE)
dat.path <-"."
qc.dat <- read.csv(file = dat.file,header = T,as.is = T)
#qc.dat$Ct_val <- as.numeric(qc.dat$Ct_val)
# qc.dat <- reactive({
#   dat <- read.delim("run258-277.v2.QC_report.csv",header = T,sep = ",",as.is = T)
#   dat <- dat[which(dat$mean_coverage > input$mincov),]
#   dat <- dat[which(qc.dat$Ct_val < input$ct),]
#   dat
# })
pagelength <- 20
```


Overview
=======================================================================

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Total sequenced samples {.value-box}

```{r total}
total <- length(qc.dat$Sample)-1
# Emit the successful
valueBox(total, icon = "fa-globe",color="darkblue")
```

### # samples with high read quality {.value-box}

```{r seq}
highqual <- length(which(qc.dat$Read_quality > 85))

# Emit the sequenced samples
valueBox(value = highqual, icon = "fa-vials", color = "blue")
```

### Samples with coverage > 40x {.value-box}

```{r success}
success <- length(which(qc.dat$Read_depth >= 40))
# Emit the successful
valueBox(success, icon = "fa-vial",color="green")
```

### Contig count > 100 {.value-box}

```{r failed}
contigs <- length(which(qc.dat$Contig_count >= 100))
# Emit the successful
valueBox(contigs, icon = "fa-vial",color="darkred")
```

### Sequenced species {.value-box}

```{r runs}
species <- length(list.files(dat.path))
# Emit the successful
valueBox(species, icon = "fa-cubes",color="orange")
```

Sample table
=======================================================================

### Table of sequenced samples

```{r table}
datatable(data=qc.dat, extensions = 'Buttons', filter="top", options = list(pageLength = 100,lengthMenu=c(20,50,100,1000),dom = 'Bfrtip', buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print')))
```


Plot Read_depth vs Contig count
=======================================================================

### Plot CT value vs. mean coverage

```{r CtvsMeancov}
ggplot(qc.dat, aes(x=Read_depth,y= Contig_count,color=Read_quality)) + 
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  ggtitle("CT ~ coverage") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1,  size = 8, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_colour_gradient(name = "Read quality") +
  labs(y = "Read depth", x = "Contig count") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=50, color="red")
```
